description: Approved baseline and platform/runtime differences for Pug Rust Compiler differential testing

affectedTests: error reporting > runtime errors > in a mixin > includes detail of where the error was thrown including the filename
error reporting > runtime errors > in a layout > includes detail of where the error was thrown including the filename
environmentDifferences.rationale: V8 9.3+ (Node.js 16.9+ / Node 22) changed the wording of TypeError when reading a property on null or undefined. Differential tests running both raw/compiler and rust/compiler on the same Node.js runtime produce identical error messages; static regexes from Node 10/12 tests accept either form.

normalizationRules.description: Replaces the compiler basedir prefix with '<basedir>' and converts Windows backslashes ('\\') to forward slashes ('/') in .filename and .message fields.
Formats generated JavaScript strings containing 'function ' with prettier@1.19.1 ({ parser: 'babel' }) for snapshot comparison, while retaining a separate raw-string comparison layer.
Serializes Node Buffer objects into { type: 'Buffer', size: buf.length, hash: md5(buf) }.

Compares PugError structured fields (code, msg, line, column, filename, src, message, toJSON()) strictly; V8 internal stack frames below the Pug template frame are excluded from cross-engine comparison.
